definition: a title at the top of a page or section of text
sentence: Each chapter has a {heading} in large letters.
translation: У каждой главы заголовок крупными буквами.

definition: a large strong building with thick walls built in the past to protect people
sentence: The {castle} on the hill is eight hundred years old.
translation: Замку на холме восемьсот лет.

definition: total, before anything is taken away, or very unpleasant
sentence: Her {gross} income is higher than her pay after tax.
translation: Её валовой доход выше, чем зарплата после налогов.

definition: a person or company that puts money into a business to make a profit
sentence: An {investor} offered a million dollars for half the company.
translation: Инвестор предложил миллион долларов за половину компании.

definition: to tell someone about a possible danger or problem
sentence: The sign is there to {warn} drivers about the sharp bend.
translation: Знак стоит, чтобы предупредить водителей о крутом повороте.

definition: the top layer of the earth in which plants grow
sentence: The {soil} in the garden is rich and dark.
translation: Почва в саду богатая и тёмная.

definition: a man in the past who fought on a horse for his king
sentence: The {knight} rode to the castle in shining armor.
translation: Рыцарь прискакал к замку в сверкающих доспехах.

definition: a person or thing that takes the place of another
sentence: The shop sent a {replacement} for the broken lamp.
translation: Магазин прислал замену сломанной лампе.

definition: a floor of a ship or bus, or a wooden platform outside a house
sentence: We stood on the {deck} and watched the dolphins.
translation: Мы стояли на палубе и смотрели на дельфинов.

definition: a dry fruit in a hard shell, or a metal ring that fits a bolt
sentence: A squirrel buried a {nut} under the tree.
translation: Белка закопала орех под деревом.

definition: only just, almost not at all
sentence: I {barely} made it to the train on time.
translation: Я едва успел на поезд.

definition: in a way that works well and produces the result you want
sentence: The new drug treats the disease very {effectively}.
translation: Новый препарат очень эффективно лечит болезнь.

definition: covering a large area or a lot of things
sentence: The storm caused {extensive} damage to the coast.
translation: Шторм нанёс обширный ущерб побережью.

definition: important in history, or likely to be remembered
sentence: The two leaders signed a {historic} peace agreement.
translation: Два лидера подписали историческое мирное соглашение.

definition: at the beginning
sentence: The project was {initially} planned to last one year.
translation: Изначально проект был рассчитан на один год.

definition: relating to or done by everyone in the world or in a group
sentence: The need for love is {universal}.
translation: Потребность в любви универсальна.

definition: extremely large in size or amount
sentence: A {vast} field of sunflowers stretched behind the house.
translation: За домом раскинулось огромное поле подсолнухов.

definition: to say firmly that something must happen or is true
sentence: My parents {insist} that I am home by ten.
translation: Родители настаивают, чтобы я был дома к десяти.

definition: to change something a little so it works better
sentence: Can you {adjust} the chair? It is too low for me.
translation: Можешь подкрутить кресло? Оно для меня слишком низкое.

definition: to show something in public, such as art or products
sentence: The gallery will {exhibit} her photographs next month.
translation: Галерея выставит её фотографии в следующем месяце.

definition: a tall stone post holding up a building, or a line of numbers going down
sentence: Each {column} of the table shows one year's sales.
translation: Каждый столбец таблицы показывает продажи за один год.

definition: a disease caused by bacteria or a virus getting into the body
sentence: The cut became red and swollen because of an {infection}.
translation: Порез покраснел и распух из-за инфекции.

definition: any living thing that is not a plant, especially an animal
sentence: A strange {creature} crawled out of the pond.
translation: Странное существо выползло из пруда.

definition: to give off bright light, or to reflect light
sentence: The sun will {shine} all day tomorrow.
translation: Завтра весь день будет светить солнце.

definition: a piece of writing in short lines, often with rhythm and rhyme
sentence: She wrote a {poem} about the sea for her mother.
translation: Она написала стихотворение о море для своей мамы.

definition: a large flat object soldiers held to protect their body, or anything that protects
sentence: The police held up a {shield} against the stones.
translation: Полицейские подняли щит против летящих камней.

definition: to break something apart with an explosion, or to make a loud noise
sentence: The workers had to {blast} through the rock to build the tunnel.
translation: Рабочим пришлось взрывать скалу, чтобы построить тоннель.

definition: the opinion that people have about someone or something
sentence: The restaurant has a {reputation} for excellent fish.
translation: У ресторана репутация заведения с отличной рыбой.

definition: everything you can see when you look across a large area of land
sentence: The {landscape} changes from forest to desert in a few miles.
translation: Пейзаж за несколько миль меняется с леса на пустыню.

definition: the act of reaching a place, or a person who has arrived
sentence: The {arrival} of the train was delayed by an hour.
translation: Прибытие поезда задержалось на час.

definition: a special set of clothes worn by all members of a group, such as pupils
sentence: All students must wear the school {uniform}.
translation: Все ученики должны носить школьную форму.

definition: something that you own, or the state of owning it
sentence: The old photo was her most precious {possession}.
translation: Старая фотография была её самым дорогим достоянием.

definition: to change words from one language into another
sentence: Can you {translate} this letter into English?
translation: Можешь перевести это письмо на английский?

definition: to be brave enough to do something risky
sentence: I would not {dare} to swim across that river.
translation: Я бы не осмелился переплыть эту реку.

definition: to make a sick person healthy again
sentence: Doctors can now {cure} many diseases that once killed people.
translation: Врачи теперь могут вылечить многие болезни, которые когда-то убивали людей.

definition: a disease, or the state of being ill
sentence: He missed a month of school because of {illness}.
translation: Он пропустил месяц школы из-за болезни.

definition: the brother of your mother or father, or your aunt's husband
sentence: My {uncle} taught me to ride a bike.
translation: Мой дядя научил меня кататься на велосипеде.

definition: a way out of a building or vehicle, or the act of leaving
sentence: Please use the {exit} at the back of the hall.
translation: Пожалуйста, воспользуйтесь выходом в задней части зала.

definition: to stay in a position for a photo or painting, or to cause a problem
sentence: The family had to {pose} for a photo on the steps.
translation: Семье пришлось позировать для фото на ступенях.

definition: to say something very loudly
sentence: You don't have to {shout}; I can hear you.
translation: Не нужно кричать, я тебя слышу.

definition: a sudden event that causes great damage or suffering, such as a flood
sentence: The earthquake was the worst {disaster} in the country's history.
translation: Землетрясение стало худшей катастрофой в истории страны.

definition: a senior priest in charge of churches in a large area
sentence: The {bishop} visited every church in the region.
translation: Епископ посетил каждую церковь в регионе.

definition: to change something completely into something different
sentence: A coat of paint {transformed} the whole room.
translation: Один слой краски полностью преобразил комнату.

definition: a long tube that carries water or gas from one place to another
sentence: A {pipe} burst and flooded the kitchen.
translation: Труба лопнула и затопила кухню.

definition: a strong feeling of shock and fear, or films and books meant to frighten
sentence: She watched in {horror} as the car hit the wall.
translation: Она с ужасом смотрела, как машина врезалась в стену.

definition: from another country or planet, or strange and unfamiliar
sentence: The customs of the village seemed {alien} to the visitors.
translation: Обычаи деревни казались гостям чужими.

definition: a set of things that come one after another in a particular order
sentence: The numbers must be entered in the correct {sequence}.
translation: Числа нужно вводить в правильной последовательности.

definition: always behaving or happening in the same way
sentence: Her results have been {consistent} all season.
translation: Её результаты были стабильными весь сезон.

definition: during the same time, or in the time between two events
sentence: Cook the pasta; {meanwhile}, I will make the sauce.
translation: Вари пасту, а я тем временем сделаю соус.

definition: as you would expect, or in a way that is not forced
sentence: {Naturally}, the children wanted to open the presents at once.
translation: Естественно, дети хотели открыть подарки сразу.

definition: in a way that cannot be avoided; used mostly in negative sentences
sentence: Expensive shoes are not {necessarily} better ones.
translation: Дорогая обувь не обязательно лучше.

definition: a piece of clothing that covers the legs from the waist to the ankles
sentence: These {pants} are too short for me.
translation: Эти брюки мне коротки.

definition: relating to real situations rather than ideas, or useful and sensible
sentence: She has a lot of {practical} experience in building houses.
translation: У неё большой практический опыт строительства домов.

definition: mainly; more than anything else
sentence: The course is {primarily} for beginners.
translation: Курс в первую очередь для начинающих.

definition: without being affected by anything else; anyway
sentence: It was raining, but we went for a walk {regardless}.
translation: Шёл дождь, но мы всё равно пошли гулять.

definition: a game in which two teams of eleven players kick a ball into a goal
sentence: My son plays {soccer} every Saturday morning.
translation: Мой сын играет в футбол каждую субботу утром.

definition: lasting only for a short time
sentence: She has a {temporary} job in a shop until September.
translation: У неё временная работа в магазине до сентября.

definition: to break suddenly with a sharp noise, or to speak angrily
sentence: The dry branch began to {snap} under his weight.
translation: Сухая ветка стала ломаться под его весом.

definition: a long tube-shaped vehicle that flies into space, or a firework
sentence: The {rocket} lifted off from the launch pad at dawn.
translation: Ракета стартовала со стартовой площадки на рассвете.

definition: a quality that makes people like you, or a small object thought to bring luck
sentence: The old town has a {charm} that new cities lack.
translation: В старом городе есть очарование, которого нет в новых городах.

definition: the long, thin part of a plant that the leaves and flowers grow from
sentence: Cut the {stem} of each rose before you put it in water.
translation: Подрежь стебель каждой розы, прежде чем ставить в воду.

definition: a small change to a law or document
sentence: The {amendment} gave women the right to vote.
translation: Поправка дала женщинам право голоса.

definition: a very large and beautiful house where a king, queen or president lives
sentence: The {palace} has over a thousand rooms.
translation: Во дворце более тысячи комнат.

definition: a large bird with a hooked beak that hunts small animals
sentence: An {eagle} circled high above the valley.
translation: Орёл кружил высоко над долиной.

definition: one of two long, flat pieces fixed to boots for moving over snow
sentence: He broke a {ski} on his first day on the mountain.
translation: Он сломал лыжу в первый же день в горах.

definition: a wide street in a town, often with trees along it
sentence: The hotel is on a quiet {avenue} lined with trees.
translation: Отель расположен на тихом проспекте, обсаженном деревьями.
